title: Auto Repair Speed auto escape self heal and more
features:
# FEATURES

## :round_pushpin: ESP Section

### Player ESP
- **Player Chams** - Highlights all players with colors based on role (Red = Monster, Green = Survivor, Gray = Eliminated)
- **Name ESP** - Shows player names, distance, and role above their heads
- **Team Check** - Toggle to only show ESP for enemies

### World ESP
- **Computer ESP** - Shows all PCs with their number and completion percentage (e.g., "PC #1 [75%]")
- **Exit ESP** - Shows exit doors with status (OPEN/READY/progress needed)

### Self Visuals
- **Self Cham** - Apply forcefield material to your character with custom color
- **Accessory Cham** - Apply forcefield to your accessories with custom color
- **Gun/Tool Cham** - Apply forcefield to tools/weapons with custom color

## :crossed_swords: Combat Section

### Aimbot (Monster Only)
- **Enable Aimbot** - Master toggle for aimbot system
- **Show FOV Circle** - Display the FOV circle on screen (Red = unlocked, Green = locked)
- **FOV Size** - Adjustable from 100 to 1500
- **Smoothness** - How fast the aimbot tracks (0.1 = slow, 1 = instant)
- **Lock On Key** - Customizable keybind (default: X) to lock onto nearest survivor

### Hitbox (Monster Only)
- **Hitbox Expander** - Makes survivor hitboxes bigger for easier hits
- **Hitbox Size** - Adjustable from 5 to 15

## :robot: Automation Section

### Main
- **Auto Repair** - Automatically completes PC repair minigames with perfect score
- **Auto Escape** - Automatically spams escape event + tweens to open exits
- **Self Heal Button** - Manually trigger self-heal when downed

### Teleport
- **Select Computer Dropdown** - Choose PC 1-12
- **Tween to Selected PC** - Smooth teleport to chosen PC and interact
- **Tween to Nearest Sabotaged PC** - Auto-find and go to nearest broken PC
- **Select Exit Dropdown** - Choose Exit 1-5
- **Tween to Exit** - Tweens to exit door -- make sure exit is opened first
- **Tween to Nearest Exit** - Go to closest exit
- **Stop Movement** - Cancel any active tween



## :person_running: Movement Section

### Speed
- **Enable Speed Hack** - Toggle speed modification
- **Walk Speed Slider** - Adjustable from 16 to 50

### Misc
- **Infinite Jump** - Jump unlimited times in air
- **No Clip** - Walk through walls
